# dodopayments_webhook (Resource)

Manages a webhook.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "dodopayments_webhook" "example" {
  url = "https://example.com/example-webhook"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `url` (String) Url of the webhook.

### Optional

- `description` (String) An example webhook name. If you remove this attribute from the configuration, the API keeps the last value.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Create the webhook in a disabled state.

Default is false. If you remove this attribute from the configuration, the API keeps the last value.
- `filter_types` (List of String) Filter events to the webhook.

Webhook event will only be sent for events in the list.
- `headers` (Map of String, Sensitive) Custom headers to be passed. A change to this value destroys the resource and creates a new resource.
- `idempotency_key` (String, Sensitive) The request's idempotency key. A change to this value destroys the resource and creates a new resource.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Metadata to be passed to the webhook
Defaut is {}. If you remove this attribute from the configuration, the API keeps the last value.
- `rate_limit` (Number) Configured rate limit.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Created at timestamp.
- `id` (String) The webhook's ID.
- `updated_at` (String) Updated at timestamp.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = dodopayments_webhook.example
  identity = {
    id = "<id>"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) The ID of the webhook.

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = dodopayments_webhook.example
  id = "<id>"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a webhook by its ID.
terraform import dodopayments_webhook.example <id>
```
